absent.description: Named digests with no committed blob.

released_bytes.description: Their summed length, released from the publisher's stored bytes.

BlobDropRequest.description:
`blob.drop`: drop named blobs while the publisher's streams are exactly as named. Publisher of
a personal database only.

heads.description: The head of every other stream of the publisher, as `log.streams` listed them. At most 32.

sha256.description: The blobs to drop: 1 to 25 digests, each once, 64 lowercase hex.

snapshot.description: The head of the publisher's snapshot stream. Its manifest may not be dropped.

BlobGetAnswer.description: The answer to a `blob.get`: exactly one download path, a presigned URL.

headers.description: Headers to send with the GET, exactly as given.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the blob, 64 lowercase hex.

BlobGetRequest.description: `blob.get`: a presigned download of one blob.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the blob, 64 lowercase hex.

BlobListAnswer.description: One page of a `blob.list`, at most 1,000 blobs.

blobs.description: The committed blobs of this page.

next.description: Present when more follow: pass it as `after`.

BlobListRequest.description: `blob.list`: the committed blobs of a database, ascending by digest, a page at a time.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the blob, 64 lowercase hex.
The SHA-256 of the blob, 64 lowercase hex.

upload.description:
On a begin for a blob the relay does not hold: where to upload it. Absent when the blob is
committed already, and on a commit.

BlobPutRequest.description: `blob.put`: begin or commit the upload of one blob, named by the SHA-256 of its bytes.

bytes.description:
The length of the blob. A relay that holds a limit on one blob answers a larger begin with
400 `invalid_request`, field `bytes`.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the blob, 64 lowercase hex.

oneOf.description: Ask for a presigned upload. A blob the relay holds already is answered without `upload`.

Confirm the upload. The relay checks the length and the recorded checksum and reads no
object bytes.

ErrorAnswer.description: The body of every answer other than 200.

field.description:
What it is about: a request field (`segment.first_seq`), a gate (`publisher`, `grant`), or
a provider (`provider.dynamo`).

grant.description:
On 403 with field `grant`: the grant index the relay consulted, for diagnosis. A relay may
leave it out.

minimum_version.description: On 426: the lowest protocol version the relay serves.

ErrorCode.description: The class of a refusal. The HTTP status goes with it (see [`ErrorCode::status`]).

oneOf.description: 400: a field is malformed or out of range; `field` names it.
400: a batch is over its cap.
401: a bad or missing request signature.
403: no current grant for this node key and role, or not the publisher.
409: the stream is not where the request needs it (a segment out of order).

409 on `blob.drop`: a stream is not as the caller named it, or was not named. Nothing was
dropped; compute the list again.
410 on `log.read`: the read starts at an entry that `log.trim` dropped.
426: the request names another protocol version.

429: a quota, rate or provider limit. `field` says whether the same request can succeed a
moment later (see [`ErrorAnswer::is_transient`]).
500: an unknown or provider failure; retry.
A code this build does not know. Never sent.

GrantDenial.description: The grant index a relay consulted for a 403 with field `grant`.

any_role.description: The role `grant#any` gives, when there is one.

database_id.description: The database whose index was read.

has_publisher.description: Whether the index has a publisher.

member_role.description: The caller's role, when it has one.

publisher.description: Whether the caller is the publisher.

publisher_node_key.description: The publisher's node key, when known.

GrantSubject.description: One grant record a relay consulted.

LogAppendAnswer.description: The answer to a `log.append`, counted in entries.

duplicate.description:
Present and true when some or all of the entries were on the relay already. They count in
`stored`, but nothing was written or charged for them.

stored.description:
Entries of this call the relay now holds, counting those it held already; for a segment,
the entries the segment holds. Equal to the entries sent when the call succeeds.

entries.description: Signed entries, each the JSON of a `mutation_log::SignedEntry`, in stream order.

segment.description: A log segment: entries whose bytes the caller put on the relay as one blob.

LogReadAnswer.description:
One page of a `log.read`. A page stops before the answer would pass 6 MB, so a short page is
not the end of a stream: the reader follows `cursor`.

cursor.description: Present when more may follow: pass it as `cursor`.

entries.description: The entries in stream order; a stored segment stands in its place as one item.

LogReadRequest.description:
`log.read`: one writer's entries, from `from_seq` of one device stream or across every device
stream, or the page after `cursor`.

cursor.description: The `cursor` of the previous page; it carries the writer, the device and the position.

device_id.description: One device stream, 64 lowercase hex. Without it, every device stream of the writer.

from_seq.description:
The first sequence number to read (default 1). A read of one device stream from a
position a trim dropped answers 410 `trimmed`.

limit.description: At most this many items (an entry or a segment each).

writer_key.description: The writer's node key, 64 lowercase hex. Required without `cursor`.

LogStreamsAnswer.description: The answer to a `log.streams`. A writer with no stream gets an empty list.

streams.description: The streams, ascending by `device_id`. A stream whose entry 1 is not stored is not listed.

writer_key.description: The writer's node key, 64 lowercase hex.

LogTrimAnswer.description:
The answer to a `log.trim`. A call does a bounded amount of work; the caller repeats while
`done` is false and adds the counts of every answer.

entries_deleted.description: Entries this call dropped, those of dropped segments included.

released_bytes.description: The stored length of the inline entries this call dropped.

LogTrimRequest.description:
`log.trim`: drop what the `snapshot` entry at `writer_seq` of stream `device_id` covers.
Publisher of a personal database only.

writer_seq.description: The sequence number of the snapshot entry.

anyOf.description: A stored log segment, in its place in the stream.

segment.description: The segment and a presigned download of its blob.

anyOf.description: One signed entry, the JSON of a `mutation_log::SignedEntry`.

SegmentAppend.description:
A log segment in a `log.append`: the signed entries `first_seq` through `last_seq` of the
caller's stream `device_id`, whose bytes are the blob `sha256` (each entry's JSON followed by
one `\n`, in order). The blob is committed through `blob.put` before the append.

bytes.description: The length of the blob, at least 1.

first_seq.description: The first entry's sequence number, at least 1.

last_hash.description: The entry hash of entry `last_seq`, 64 lowercase hex.

last_seq.description: The last entry's sequence number, at least `first_seq`.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the blob, 64 lowercase hex.

SegmentRef.description:
A stored log segment as `log.read` names it, with the `blob.get` answer for its blob. The
reader checks that the blob holds exactly entries `first_seq` through `last_seq` of the
stream, in order, and that the last one's hash is `last_hash`.

headers.description: Headers to send with the GET, exactly as given.

last_hash.description: The entry hash of entry `last_seq`, 64 lowercase hex.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the blob, 64 lowercase hex.

StreamHead.description: One device stream and its contiguous head.

head_hash.description: The entry hash of entry `head_seq`, 64 lowercase hex.

head_seq.description: The highest sequence number such that every one from 1 up to it is stored.

Upload.description:
A presigned upload. The client sends exactly `headers` (they carry the checksum the store
enforces), except `content-length`, which it sets itself.

headers.description: Headers to send with the PUT.
